phase: CD-1B — PIT Sector Infrastructure (four core axes on L2)
authority: user GO ruling 2026-10-04 (granularity contract; three-tier semantic registry; L3 escalation mechanism; TDX as L3-A current layer)

granularity_contract.historical_production_granularity: L2_csrc v1-static-declared (83 sectors, coverage 99.94%, census PASS)
granularity_contract.l3_role: supplementary decomposition layer, NOT in CD-1B hard dependency chain
granularity_contract.l3_a_current: tdx_v1 taxonomy for CURRENT / near-current structure, rotation, sub-industry decomposition, stock-selection context
granularity_contract.l3_b_backcast: RETROSPECTIVE_GROUPING ONLY — allowed for research/explanation/sensitivity/visualization with mandatory label classification_mode=RETROSPECTIVE_CURRENT_L3; PROHIBITED as primary historical decision signal, as strategy threshold source, or pretending the classification existed then

semantic_registry.PIT: data formed/available at decision time T; the only mode admitted to historical decision signals
semantic_registry.STATIC_DECLARED: current snapshot extended backward under an explicit declared assumption (change_frequency UNKNOWN); usable in historical production ONLY with mandatory declaration and downgrade record (L2_csrc is this mode)
semantic_registry.RETROSPECTIVE_GROUPING: today's grouping used to look at past behavior; research/explanation only; never a historical decision signal
semantic_registry.note: replaces binary legal/illegal; every sector artifact must carry its mode

l3_escalation_spec_frozen_as_design.principle: L3 is resolution-on-demand, not default infrastructure; L2 runs first, L3 opens only when L2 information is insufficient
trigger_candidates_L2_INTERNAL_HETEROGEN: volume-weighted return strong while equal-weighted return weak
top5 vs remaining members directional split
l3_escalation_spec_frozen_as_design.flow: L2 state homogeneous -> accept L2 state; L2 internally split -> L3 decomposition
l3_escalation_spec_frozen_as_design.status: SPEC ONLY in CD-1B (no L3 logic built this phase); operationalization thresholds deferred to the phase that consumes them

four_core_axes_operators_preregistered.input: DATA-1 daily (unadj OHLCV + adjust_factor model_derived) x L2_csrc v1-static membership; ONLY trailing data through T (no future windows)

axis_1_relative_performance.sector_return_eq: cross-sectional mean of member daily returns (qfq-adjusted via adjust_factor; members traded on T with a prior close)
axis_1_relative_performance.sector_return_vw: volume-weighted mean (raw volume; DECLARED model_derived substitute for amount until EM backfill)
axis_1_relative_performance.market_return_eq: cross-sectional mean over all stocks with data on T (equal-weight market proxy)
axis_1_relative_performance.parent_return_eq_vw: same operators on the L1 parent aggregate

axis_2_participation.sector_volume: sum of member raw volume on T
axis_2_participation.market_volume: sum over all stocks on T

axis_3_breadth.advance_fraction: fraction of participating members with close>prev_close (qfq)
axis_3_breadth.volume_confirmed_fraction: fraction of participating members with volume > trailing 20-session mean volume of that member (strictly prior 20 sessions)
axis_3_breadth.new_high_participation: fraction of participating members whose qfq close = max(qfq close over trailing 60 sessions incl. T)

axis_4_concentration.return_contribution_top3_top5: sum of the 3/5 largest POSITIVE member (weight x return) contributions / sum of all positive contributions (zero-denominator -> NULL, never imputed)
axis_4_concentration.volume_concentration_top3_top5: sum of top 3/5 member volumes / sector volume
axis_4_concentration.split_indicator_inputs: top5 mean return vs rest mean return (for the escalation spec)

common_rules.min_participation_floor: a (sector,date) cell requires >=5 participating members, else emitted as INSUFFICIENT_PARTICIPATION (fail-closed)
common_rules.suspended_stocks: no trade on T -> not participating that day (never forward/backward filled)
common_rules.no_final_score: axes are emitted as separate observables; NO composite strength score, NO ranking (that is CD-2+ business and requires its own preregistration)

engine_contract.determinism: pure function of (DATA-1 files, membership file); dual-run byte-identical sha required
engine_contract.output: per-(sector,date) rows keyed (l2_code, date) stored as partitioned gzip JSON under data/cd/sector_axes/; coverage report of emitted rows vs expected (sector x calendar) with fail-closed gap list
engine_contract.resources: streaming per-date computation, memory <=2.5G, batched, resumable, no single intermediate >2GB
engine_contract.pit_discipline: all window features are trailing-only (20d/60d lookback ends at T inclusive); no forward returns anywhere in this table

tdx_l3a_acquisition.source: tdx.com.cn installer (HTTP reachable verified) -> 7z extract tdxhy.cfg -> parse to data/cd/sector_seeds/tdx_v1.json (v1-static-declared header)
tdx_l3a_acquisition.census: coverage vs DATA-1 universe (target >=95%); member-count distribution; if fail -> explicit downgrade record
tdx_l3a_acquisition.role: L3-A current decomposition candidate ONLY; not in CD-1B dependency chain
tdx_l3a_acquisition.future_audit_deferred: L3_STATIC_BACKCAST_RISK_AUDIT (company stability; L3-changes-L2-conclusions?; stable-incumbent-subset sensitivity) recorded, NOT started
